notes.title: Guidlines and storage update
notes.content:
Now basic food and materials storage is = 60.
When housing, and materials storage is full the guidelines will say so and will inform that workers will not gather resources.

notes.title: Storage update!
notes.content: Workers stop working when storage is full.

notes.title: Update for selecting objects
notes.content: Now there is a second option to select objects you want to cut, mine, and gather. By clicking objects now you can select them.
